verdict.rationale: Openness is a fair question for a GPU, since buyers can reasonably ask about open-source drivers, firmware or hardware designs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code, open-source drivers or any open license for the RTX 5080 or its software stack. The CUDA Toolkit, DLSS and NVIDIA app citations describe features, not source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
